title: A Carefree Drift
author: Lopamudra Singh
text:
I soak my heart in brine,
In all that sunshine.
Like sipping a fine
Bottle of red wine.

Mesmerized by the air,
And with not a single care,
I want to drift far
From this worldly fair.

Lost among the bushes,
Under the waterfall that gushes;
I get lost in the fog,
Drifting like a lost log.

Gathering the wild flowers,
Spending the warm hours;
From the green grass field,
Waiting to be yield.

I gather all pollen,
And snuggle in my woolen;
Like a carefree bee,
That wants to be free.

I stumble on a rock,
Waking to the clock;
With a big wide yawn,
Realizing it`s all gone.

But I will return,
To the same loving urn;
I long each night,
No matter how difficult it might.
stanzas: I soak my heart in brine,
And with not a single care,
I get lost in the fog,
No matter how difficult it might.
